summary: No new receipt this turn; I restored a bounding nuance that had been dropped when the interpretation was rewritten and that a reviewer needs in order to size the empty-configuration case. The record now states explicitly that what such a node loses is membership context and the ability to campaign, not data flow: in the partial-restart receipts (7afe8c0403874dbeb0a917a3ee9ed837 and its repeat 2963a0b01d97404dbf946e7b87a214f8) the two configuration-less nodes still appended and applied entries up to log index 13 while the correctly configured voter led, and they still granted the votes that let it win, so replication through a configured leader continues; the observable harm is their empty self-view — no campaigns and no peers — and, once the configured voter stops, the cluster-wide loss of electability recorded in those same receipts. The account is otherwise unchanged: trigger, mechanism, the three consequence classes, the safety violation, progress losses, client-contract consequence, repair paths, controls, reproducibility and negative results all stand as recorded, with no open gaps.
